첼시's Premier League continues into 2006 by 11 points over 맨체스터 유나이티드, while 리버풀's good run of form has taken them into third place. 토트넘 홋스퍼 and 위건 애슬레틱 complete the top five. 선덜랜드, 버밍엄 시티 and 포츠머스 occupy the relegation places. Reading still lead the Championship, with 셰필드 유나이티드, Leeds, 왓퍼드, 크리스털 팰리스 and 울버햄프턴 원더러스 completing the top six. 셰필드 웬즈데이, 밀월 and Crewe finish the year in the relegation zone.
